title: Wizard's Study
description: A woman in a white robe with purple hair stands at a wooden desk in a magical study, examining an open book illuminated by a glowing purple lantern. The room is filled with ancient books, numerous glowing potion bottles on ornate shelves, scattered papers, red wax seals, and a large arched stained-glass window with red curtains.
prompt: A detailed fantasy scene of a female alchemist with purple hair in a bun wearing a white robe standing at a large wooden desk in an ornate study. She is reading an ancient open book with glowing green butterflies on the pages. The room has tall curved shelves filled with colorful glowing potions in glass bottles, scattered magical papers, red wax seals, and a large arched stained glass window with red velvet curtains letting in warm light.
